children: Signet Jewelers entered into a Second Amended and Restated Credit Card Program Agreement with Comenity Bank and Comenity Capital Bank to continue and combine its private-label credit card programs. The agreement runs through December 31, 2035, includes an exclusivity arrangement for U.S. open-ended credit products under key Signet brands, and features a signing bonus and a profit-sharing component. Subject to conditions, Signet may purchase the program assets at expiration or termination at the greater of fair value or par.
